question:
Four different positions of the same dice are given below. Find the letter opposite of c.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d31285afd46b6f0ba760d93342d6235cdec53aa153189773f2772dc17509d42.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'c', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ba09d60b9de01531c1ef0e5130dc53e48d6ced4af19d84c2df78085aa33af70.png] 

From both dices, d and e are common.

So, the remaining 'f' will be the opposite face of 'c'.

Hence, the correct answer is "f".
